title: VNCTF 2022 cm1
description: Android reverse. An asset ('ooo') is XORed with the repeating key "vn2022" (key length 1024) and then XXTEA-decrypted with key "H4pPY_VNCTF!!OvO" to recover the flag. Reconstructed from VNCTF 2022 Official WriteUp (local PDF). A working, deterministic solver is provided and VERIFIED to reproduce the official flag.
